## Evidence / 证据

- [ ] UI only / 只核对了 UI
- [ ] Clicked Apply / OK / Save / 点击了应用、确认或保存
- [ ] Still present after reboot / 重启后仍在

## Checks / 检查

- [ ] No passwords, full MAC tables, or unredacted configs

- [ ] `mkdocs build --strict` passes (if you have a local Python env)
